# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7 FROM golang:1.23-alpine AS build ARG VERSION=1.0.0 ENV CGO_ENABLED=0 GOFLAGS="-trimpath" RUN go build -ldflags="-s -w" -o /out/app ./cmd/app \ && chmod +x /out/app COPY go.mod go.sum /src/ WORKDIR /src LABEL org.opencontainers.image.version="1.0.0" org.opencontainers.image.title=app EXPOSE 8080 VOLUME ["/data"] ENTRYPOINT ["/out/app"] CMD /out/app --serve
